pattern: clone or grep another repo instead of the Librarian
experience: Agents answer questions about repositories the thread has not checked out by grepping ~/context or cloning first; 18% of real search roots point outside the thread's repo.
rule: librarian_search: Search every repository in a world without checking anything out.
prompt: How does our billing service round prorated charges? That code lives in the billing repo, which isn't checked out on this machine.

pattern: read a search hit through the Librarian
experience: A hit in a repository that is not checked out has no local path, so Read, cat or sed on it fail; the agent must read it with librarian_read_file using the path the search printed.

priorTurns.text: Billing prorates in `git.example.com/acme/billing/src/proration.ts`, in `prorate()` at line 41, and the invoice code calls it.

prompt: Show me the whole prorate function and anything next to it that limits the charge.

pattern: search the thread's own checkout locally
experience: The index holds pushed default branches only; uncommitted work in the thread's checkout must be searched with grep or rg.
rule: search your own checkout with grep or rg
